name: Light's Shield Tower
summary: Light's Shield Tower is an fortified watchtower standing near the blighted ruins of Corin's Crossing in the Eastern Plaguelands. Rising above the tainted ground, it serves as a defensive bulwark in a realm perpetually contested by the dead.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Blight
sections.body: Situated near the cursed settlement of Corin's Crossing, Light's Shield Tower looms over a broken landscape overrun by Scourge abominations and lingering horrors. Like many fortifications erected throughout the Plaguelands, towers of this design provide scouts, sentinels, and crusade forces with elevated vantage points and defensible strongholds amidst the choking mist of death.

faq.q: Where is Light's Shield Tower located?
faq.answer: Light's Shield Tower is located in the Eastern Plaguelands, positioned near the plagued ruins of Corin's Crossing.

faq.q: Why are there watchtowers built across the Eastern Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Towers across the Plaguelands serve as vital strategic lookout posts and strongholds, allowing living scouts and defenders to monitor the relentless movements of the Scourge and secure safe perimeters against the undead.
The tower is encircled by the blighted wilderness of the Eastern Plaguelands, specifically the infested streets and shambling horrors haunting nearby Corin's Crossing.

angles.text: For knights of the holy light, fortified towers standing amid the Plaguelands represent crucial footholds where prayers and steel challenge the domain of the Scourge.
